body:
**Primitives (auto-inferred):** `string`, `number`, `date`, `bool`.

**Status / categorical:** `status`, `tags`, `checkmark`, `checkbox`
(interactive + persisted, requires `id` column), `rating`, `progress`.

**Numeric:** `currency`, `percentage`, `filesize`.

**Identity / links:** `url`, `email`, `phone`, `avatar` (initials or
image), `id`.

**Temporal / text:** `date`, `relative`, `code`.

**Visual:** `color` (hex → swatch), `icon` (15-icon curated set),
`country` (ISO-2 → flag emoji), `sparkline`, `duration`, `range`,
`code-block`, `json`, `image` (absolute URL → thumbnail).
